headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 5 studies yielded an effect size of 1.37 (95% CI: 0.87–2.17), indicating no statistically significant association between polyunsaturated fat (pufa) and prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 88.70%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
